description: This script sets up and tests git pull message generation and log output. It includes tests for commit history, file content modifications, and output verification.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit with a file named 'afile' and 'original' content.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate passage of time between commits.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label and commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
